title: FRED Inflation Monitor CPI
description: Tracks Consumer Price Index data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED. Captures headline CPI, core CPI (ex food & energy), and the PCE deflator (the Fed's preferred inflation measure). Calculates year-over-year and month-over-month changes. Inflation above the Fed's 2% target means rates stay higher for longer - bearish for growth stocks and bonds, bullish for commodities and value plays.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('CPIAUCSL', 'cpi_all_urban', 'Headline CPI (All Urban Consumers)'),
    ('CPILFESL', 'core_cpi', 'Core CPI (Ex Food & Energy)'),
    ('PCEPI', 'pce_deflator', 'PCE Price Index (Fed preferred)'),
    ('PCEPILFE', 'core_pce', 'Core PCE (Ex Food & Energy)'),
    ('CPIENGSL', 'cpi_energy', 'CPI Energy Component'),
    ('CPIUFDSL', 'cpi_food', 'CPI Food Component'),
]

rows = []
for i in range(len(SERIES)):
    series_id = SERIES[i][0]
    label = SERIES[i][1]
    description = SERIES[i][2]

    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 13,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])

    valid = []
    for o in obs:
        if o.get('value', '.') != '.':
            valid.append(o)

    if len(valid) < 2:
        continue

    latest = float(valid[0]['value'])
    prev_month = float(valid[1]['value'])
    mom_change = round(((latest - prev_month) / prev_month) * 100, 4) if prev_month > 0 else 0.0

    yoy_change = 0.0
    if len(valid) >= 13:
        year_ago = float(valid[12]['value'])
        yoy_change = round(((latest - year_ago) / year_ago) * 100, 2) if year_ago > 0 else 0.0

    # Fed target assessment
    if 'pce' in label or 'cpi' in label:
        if yoy_change > 4.0:
            inflation_status = 'HOT'
        elif yoy_change > 2.5:
            inflation_status = 'ELEVATED'
        elif yoy_change > 1.5:
            inflation_status = 'TARGET_RANGE'
        else:
            inflation_status = 'COOL'
    else:
        inflation_status = 'N/A'

    rows.append({
        'series_id': series_id,
        'metric': label,
        'description': description,
        'latest_value': latest,
        'latest_date': valid[0].get('date', ''),
        'mom_change_pct': mom_change,
        'yoy_change_pct': yoy_change,
        'inflation_status': inflation_status,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
